privacyPolicy.title: Rascunho português: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: Rascunho português: This Privacy Policy explains what information Toolars collects, how we use it, and the choices you have. Toolars is built local-first: traditional calculators and PDF tools run in your browser and do not upload your input unless an AI or cloud step is explicitly enabled.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: Information we collect
paragraphs: Rascunho português: Account information. When you sign in with Google, we receive your Google account ID, name, and email address as returned by Google. We use these to identify your workspace and sync your saved collections, history, and settings.

Rascunho português: Content you process. Traditional calculators (BMI, mortgage, loan, retirement, and all VitalCalc tools) process your input entirely in your browser. The values you enter never leave your device. PDF tools marked Local process files in your browser; when an AI summarize or cloud step is enabled, the relevant content is sent to the configured provider only after you grant explicit AI consent.
Rascunho português: Usage data. We collect aggregated, anonymized analytics about which tools are used and errors encountered, so we can improve reliability. We do not sell or rent this data.

Rascunho português: Cookies and local storage. We use a minimal set of cookies and local storage entries: a session cookie when you are signed in, an AI consent preference, a cookie consent choice, and your theme/appearance preference. See the Cookies section below.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: How we use your information
paragraphs: Rascunho português: To provide the tools and features you request, including saving your workspace history and collections to your account.
Rascunho português: To operate AI steps that you explicitly enable, sending only the content required for that step to the configured AI provider.
Rascunho português: To maintain the security and integrity of the service, detect abuse, and comply with legal obligations.
Rascunho português: We do not use your information to train AI models, and we do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: AI consent and data processing
paragraphs: Rascunho português: Toolars labels every step as Local, Cloud, or AI. Steps marked Local never transmit your data. Steps marked AI or Cloud require your explicit consent before any content is sent to a provider.

Rascunho português: Your AI consent choice is recorded per workspace. You can review and revoke AI consent at any time from Settings → Privacy & AI. Revoking consent disables AI and cloud steps until you re-enable them.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: Cookies
paragraphs: Rascunho português: Toolars uses the following categories of cookies and local storage:
Rascunho português: Strictly necessary. The signed session cookie (when signed in) is required for authentication and cannot be disabled.
Rascunho português: Preferences. Your AI consent choice, cookie consent choice, and appearance preference are stored locally so the site remembers them on your next visit.
Rascunho português: Analytics. Optional, anonymized analytics run only if you accept them in the cookie consent banner. You can withdraw analytics consent at any time.
Rascunho português: You can clear preferences and analytics storage at any time using your browser settings or from Settings → Privacy & AI.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: Data retention
paragraphs: Rascunho português: We retain your account information and workspace data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, we remove your personal data within 30 days.

Rascunho português: AI consent and run logs are retained to provide an auditable record of your consent choices, as required for accountability under GDPR Article 7(1). You can export these logs from Settings → Privacy & AI.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: Your privacy rights
paragraphs: Rascunho português: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights over your personal data:
Rascunho português: Access. Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
Rascunho português: Rectification. Ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
Rascunho português: Erasure. Request deletion of your personal data (the 'right to be forgotten').
Rascunho português: Restriction and objection. Ask us to restrict or stop processing your data.
Rascunho português: Data portability. Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
Rascunho português: Withdraw consent. Withdraw your AI, analytics, or cookie consent at any time without affecting processing carried out before withdrawal.

Rascunho português: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at the address below. We respond within 30 days. If you are in the European Economic Area, United Kingdom, or California, these rights are guaranteed under the GDPR and CCPA respectively.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: International data transfers
paragraphs: Rascunho português: When you enable an AI or cloud step, your content may be processed by providers located outside your country of residence, including the United States. We rely on standard contractual clauses and provider data processing agreements to ensure appropriate safeguards for such transfers.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: Children's privacy
paragraphs: Rascunho português: Toolars is not directed at children under 13 (or the equivalent minimum age in your jurisdiction) and we do not knowingly collect personal data from them. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: Rascunho português: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The 'last updated' date at the top reflects the most recent change. Material changes will be highlighted on the site at least seven days before they take effect.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: Contact us
paragraphs: Rascunho português: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or want to exercise your data rights, email privacy@toolars.app. Include 'Privacy Request' in the subject line.

termsOfService.title: Rascunho português: Terms of Service
termsOfService.intro: Rascunho português: These Terms of Service govern your use of Toolars. By accessing or using the site, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: Use of the service
paragraphs: Rascunho português: You may use Toolars for lawful personal and commercial purposes. Traditional calculators and PDF tools are free to use during the beta.
Rascunho português: You are responsible for the content you process and for ensuring you have the rights to use any files you upload for AI or cloud steps.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: Acceptable use
paragraphs: Rascunho português: You agree not to: use the service for any unlawful purpose; upload content that infringes the rights of others; attempt to access, disrupt, or reverse-engineer systems you are not authorized to access; use automated means to scrape or overload the service; or submit malicious files or prompts designed to exploit the AI features.
Rascunho português: Violations may result in suspension of your account and, where applicable, referral to the relevant authorities.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: AI features and consent
paragraphs: Rascunho português: AI and cloud steps are optional and require your explicit consent before any content is processed by a third-party provider. You are responsible for reviewing which steps are AI-assisted before enabling them.
Rascunho português: AI-generated output may be inaccurate. You are responsible for verifying AI results before relying on them. Toolars is not liable for decisions made based on AI output.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: Your content
paragraphs: Rascunho português: You retain ownership of the content you process with Toolars. By using cloud or AI steps, you grant the configured provider a license to process that content solely to provide the step you requested.
Rascunho português: Traditional calculator and local PDF tool inputs remain on your device and are not licensed to Toolars or any provider.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: Accounts
paragraphs: Rascunho português: You are responsible for safeguarding the account credentials provided by your chosen sign-in method and for all activity under your account. Notify us immediately at security@toolars.app if you suspect unauthorized access.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: Fees and beta
paragraphs: Rascunho português: Traditional tools are free during the beta. AI and cloud steps may consume credits or incur charges when paid plans launch. Material changes to pricing will be announced at least 14 days in advance.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: Disclaimer of warranties
paragraphs: Rascunho português: The service is provided 'as is' and 'as available' without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied. Calculator results are provided for informational purposes and are not medical, financial, or legal advice. Always consult a qualified professional for such advice.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: Rascunho português: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Toolars shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or any loss of profits or data, arising out of your use of the service.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: Indemnification
paragraphs: Rascunho português: You agree to indemnify and hold Toolars harmless from claims, damages, and expenses arising from your misuse of the service or your violation of these Terms.

sections.heading: Rascunho português: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: Rascunho português: We may update these Terms from time to time. The 'last updated' date at the top reflects the most recent change. Continued use of the service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

issues.injectionRoleChange: Tenta alterar o papel do modelo.
issues.injectionTemplate: Entrada em estilo de template pode permitir substituição não confiável.
issues.leakageExplicit: Linguagem de sigilo no prompt pode convidar tentativas de vazamento.
issues.leakageExposure: O prompt expõe estrutura de papéis ou instruções.
issues.bypassSafety: O prompt inclui linguagem de bypass de segurança.
issues.bypassJailbreak: O prompt inclui enquadramento de jailbreak.
issues.roleConfusion: O prompt confunde papéis de assistant, user, admin ou developer.
issues.roleDenial: O prompt pede que o assistant negue seu papel de AI.
issues.dataPII: O prompt parece incluir campos com formato de PII.

workspace.mitigationsDescription: Transforme achados em um checklist focado para o responsável pelo prompt.

mitigations.waiting: Execute uma verificação para gerar orientação de mitigação.
mitigations.safe: Nenhum problema de proteção detectado. Mantenha a revisão local ativada para prompts do sistema sensíveis.
mitigations.mitigationIgnore: Separe instruções confiáveis de conteúdo do usuário ou recuperado e rejeite tentativas de substituição.
mitigations.mitigationRoleChange: Mantenha a hierarquia de papéis explícita e bloqueie solicitações que atribuam nova autoridade.
mitigations.mitigationTemplate: Valide variáveis de template e escape substituições não confiáveis antes de montar o prompt.
mitigations.mitigationLeakage: Evite iscas de sigilo e mantenha detalhes de política ocultos fora de superfícies de prompt visíveis ao usuário.
mitigations.mitigationExposure: Mova a estrutura interna de instruções para configuração confiável quando possível.
mitigations.mitigationBypass: Remova linguagem de bypass e exija exceções de segurança permitidas por allowlist.
mitigations.mitigationJailbreak: Rejeite enquadramento de jailbreak antes que o prompt chegue a modelos downstream.
mitigations.mitigationRole: Esclareça os limites de assistant, user, admin e developer em instruções confiáveis.
mitigations.mitigationRoleDenial: Remova linguagem de negação de identidade e mantenha definições de papel estáveis.
mitigations.mitigationCredentials: Remova credenciais e rotacione qualquer segredo que apareceu no texto do prompt.
mitigations.mitigationPII: Oculte campos com formato de PII antes de qualquer workflow de AI ou logging.

reviewItems.secrets: Remova credenciais, tokens e dados de clientes de prompts do sistema.
reviewItems.injection: Mantenha instruções resistentes a substituição separadas do texto recuperado.
reviewItems.roles: Preserve a hierarquia de papéis e os limites de autoridade das ferramentas.

workspace.handoffCopy: Este espaço de trabalho nativo do Toolars migra as regras System Prompt Guard do Aixtral para o design system do AI Developer Lab.
